script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars forms a tense square to your ruling planet Venus, creating friction in your 7th House of Partnerships. Meanwhile, Jupiter stations direct in your 2nd House of Finances, blessing income potential with unexpected opportunities. In love, single Taurus should watch for unexpected encounters at creative events, as Venus's trine to Neptune heightens romantic idealism and genuine connection potential. Those already coupled may feel a restless urge to redefine relationship boundaries, requiring honest conversations about unmet needs. Professionally, this is a powerful day to negotiate raises or launch financial projects, as your practical Earth sign skills shine under Jupiter's optimistic gaze and organizational talents receive public recognition from authority figures. Your stubbornness is the only obstacle so release control and trust the process as a surprising blessing arrives through an unexpected financial windfall or promotion. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
